content.text:
I've submitted index 23 (Co 0.23 / Sb 0.77) as the best composition. It had the highest EQE I measured, 0.034%. All 3 EQE measurements and all 5 XRD measurements are used.

| Index | Sb fraction | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 10 | 0.35 | 0.00019 |
| 20 | 0.67 | 0.0063 |
| 23 | 0.77 | 0.034 |

- **Phase scan:** I ran XRD at indices 4, 10, 15, 20 and 25. From Sb ≈ 0.5 up to the Sb-rich end, the scans show a CoSb₂O₆-type (trirutile) phase. The Co-rich scans (indices 4 and 10) have mostly weak peaks, which suggests poorly crystalline or mixed material.
- **Phase interpretation:** Three strong peaks show up at every composition, probably from the substrate. So the phase assignment is my reading of the other peaks, not a confirmed fit.
- **EQE trend:** Merit rose steeply with Sb fraction, about 180-fold from index 10 to index 23.

**Uncertainty:** I never measured EQE for indices 24 to 27, which are even richer in Sb. The trend was still rising at index 23, so one of those could be better. I'm confident the Co-rich half of the library isn't competitive.
